## Synopsis

```text
Meziantou.Framework.AtlassianDataFormat.Tool [options]
```

## Description

Convert Atlassian Document Format (ADF) documents to Markdown using Meziantou.Framework.AtlassianDataFormat

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--input <input>` | Path to the ADF JSON file to convert. If omitted, reads from stdin |  |
| `--output <output>` | Path to the Markdown file to write. If omitted, writes to stdout |  |
| `--heading-style <Atx\|Setext>` | Style used for headings | `Atx` |
| `--emphasis-marker <Asterisk\|Underscore>` | Marker used for emphasis | `Asterisk` |
| `--code-block-style <Fenced\|Indented>` | Style used for code blocks | `Fenced` |
| `--code-block-fence-character <code-block-fence-character>` | Fence character used for fenced code blocks | `` ` `` |
| `--unordered-list-marker <unordered-list-marker>` | Marker used for unordered lists | `-` |
| `--thematic-break <thematic-break>` | Text used for horizontal rules | `---` |
| `--line-break-style <Backslash\|TrailingSpaces>` | Style used for line breaks | `TrailingSpaces` |
| `--panel-style <Blockquote\|GitHubAlert\|Html\|PlainText>` | Style used for panels | `Blockquote` |
| `--expand-style <Blockquote\|Heading\|HtmlDetails>` | Style used for collapsible sections | `Blockquote` |
| `--table-style <Auto\|Html\|PipeTable>` | Style used for tables | `PipeTable` |
| `--media-rendering <AltText\|Image\|Link\|Skip>` | Rendering used for media items | `Image` |
| `--emoji-rendering <ShortName\|Text>` | Rendering used for emoji | `Text` |
| `--task-list-style <Checkbox\|PlainText>` | Style used for task lists | `Checkbox` |
| `--decision-list-style <BulletList\|PlainText>` | Style used for decision lists | `BulletList` |
| `--unknown-node-handling <KeepContent\|Skip\|Throw>` | Handling of nodes whose type is not part of the supported schema | `Skip` |
| `--mention-format <mention-format>` | Format used for mentions, where {text} is the display name and {id} the account identifier | `@{text}` |
| `--status-format <status-format>` | Format used for status lozenges, where {text} is the text and {color} the color | `` `{text}` `` |
| `--date-format <date-format>` | Format used for dates, applied with the invariant culture | `yyyy-MM-dd` |
| `-?`, `-h`, `--help` | Show help and usage information |  |
| `--version` | Show version information |  |
